subject: Biology SL
title: Biology SL Paper 2 Section A Mock v1

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Answer all parts about DNA structure and replication.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: State the complementary DNA base to cytosine.
markscheme: Guanine.
markschemeJa: グアニン。
parts.modelAnswer: The complementary base to cytosine is guanine.
parts.modelAnswerJa: シトシンと相補的に塩基対をつくるのはグアニンです。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why DNA replication is described as semi-conservative.
markscheme: The two parental DNA strands separate and each acts as a template for a new complementary strand.
Each daughter DNA molecule contains one parental strand and one newly synthesized strand.
markschemeJa: 親DNAの2本鎖が分離し、それぞれが新しい相補鎖をつくる鋳型になる。
複製後の各DNA分子は親鎖1本と新しく合成された鎖1本を含む。
parts.modelAnswer: The parental strands separate and each directs synthesis of a complementary new strand. Each daughter DNA molecule therefore contains one original strand and one newly synthesized strand.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 親DNAの2本鎖が分かれ、それぞれを鋳型として新しい相補鎖が合成されます。そのため複製後の各DNA分子は、親由来の鎖1本と新生鎖1本を含みます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: A DNA molecule contains 30% adenine. Explain the expected percentages of thymine and cytosine in the same double-stranded molecule.
markscheme: Thymine is expected to be 30% because adenine pairs with thymine.
Adenine plus thymine accounts for 60%, leaving 40% for guanine plus cytosine.
Cytosine is expected to be 20% because guanine and cytosine occur in equal proportions in double-stranded DNA.
markschemeJa: アデニンはチミンと対になるので、チミンも30%と予想される。
AとTで60%を占めるため、GとCに残るのは40%である。
二本鎖DNAではGとCの割合が等しいため、シトシンは20%と予想される。
parts.modelAnswer: Thymine should also be 30% because A pairs with T. That leaves 40% for G and C together. Because G pairs with C, they should each make up 20% of the nucleotides.
parts.modelAnswerJa: AとTは相補的に対になるためTも30%です。残り40%をGとCが等しく占めるので、Cは20%になります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A student investigated osmosis using equal cylinders of potato tissue.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Estimate the sucrose concentration at which there is no net change in tissue mass.
markscheme: Approximately 0.35 mol dm⁻³ (accept a reasonable estimate between 0.3 and 0.4 mol dm⁻³).
markschemeJa: 約0.35 mol dm⁻³（0.3〜0.4 mol dm⁻³の妥当な推定を可）。
parts.modelAnswer: The zero mass-change point is approximately 0.35 mol dm⁻³.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 質量変化が0になる点は約0.35 mol dm⁻³です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why potato tissue gains mass in 0.10 mol dm⁻³ sucrose solution.
markscheme: The external solution has a higher water potential than the potato cell contents.
Water enters the cells by osmosis across partially permeable cell membranes, increasing tissue mass.
markschemeJa: 外液はジャガイモ細胞内容物より水ポテンシャルが高い。
水が部分透過性膜を通って浸透により細胞内へ入り、組織の質量が増える。
parts.modelAnswer: The dilute sucrose solution has a higher water potential than the cell contents, so water enters the cells by osmosis through partially permeable membranes. This increases the mass of the tissue.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 薄いスクロース溶液は細胞内より水ポテンシャルが高いため、水が部分透過性膜を通って細胞内へ浸透し、組織の質量が増えます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Suggest two variables that should be controlled when comparing the sucrose solutions.
markscheme: Control the size or initial mass/surface area of the potato cylinders.
Control another relevant condition such as immersion time, temperature, solution volume or potato source.
markschemeJa: ジャガイモ片の大きさ、初期質量、表面積などを一定にする。
浸漬時間、温度、溶液量、ジャガイモの由来など別の適切な条件を一定にする。
parts.modelAnswer: The potato cylinders should have the same dimensions or initial mass, and conditions such as immersion time and temperature should also be kept constant.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ジャガイモ片の大きさや初期質量をそろえ、浸漬時間や温度などの条件も一定にします。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest one change that would improve the reliability of the estimate of the zero mass-change concentration.
markscheme: Use replicate potato cylinders at each concentration and calculate a mean (or use more concentrations with smaller intervals near the zero point).
markschemeJa: 各濃度で複数の反復を行って平均を求める（または0点付近で濃度間隔を小さくする）。
parts.modelAnswer: Use several replicate cylinders at each concentration and calculate a mean; using smaller concentration intervals around the zero point would further improve the estimate.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 各濃度で複数の反復を行い平均を求めます。さらに0点付近の濃度間隔を細かくすると推定精度が上がります。

stimulus.title: Sucrose concentration and potato mass change
stimulus.description: Equal potato cylinders were immersed for 40 minutes.
stimulus.note: Positive values indicate a gain in mass.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: An enzyme reaction was measured at increasing substrate concentration.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Describe the relationship between substrate concentration and reaction rate.
markscheme: Reaction rate increases as substrate concentration increases at low to moderate substrate concentrations.
The increase becomes smaller and the rate approaches a plateau at high substrate concentration.
markschemeJa: 低〜中程度の基質濃度では、基質濃度が上がると反応速度が上昇する。
高い基質濃度では上昇幅が小さくなり、反応速度は頭打ちに近づく。
parts.modelAnswer: The reaction rate rises rapidly at first as substrate concentration increases, but the increase becomes progressively smaller and the curve approaches a plateau.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 基質濃度が上がると最初は反応速度が大きく上昇しますが、次第に増加幅が小さくなり、最終的に頭打ちに近づきます。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why the reaction rate approaches a plateau at high substrate concentration.
markscheme: At high substrate concentration, most enzyme active sites are occupied for much of the time.
Enzyme concentration becomes limiting, so adding more substrate produces little further increase in rate.
markschemeJa: 高い基質濃度では、多くの酵素活性部位がほとんど常に基質で占有される。
酵素濃度が制限要因となるため、基質を増やしても速度はほとんど上がらない。
parts.modelAnswer: At high substrate concentration, the enzyme becomes saturated because most active sites are occupied. The amount of enzyme then limits the maximum rate, so additional substrate has little effect.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 高い基質濃度では多くの活性部位が占有され、酵素が飽和します。その後は酵素量が制限要因となるため、基質を増やしても反応速度はほとんど上がりません。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Predict the effect of a competitive inhibitor at low substrate concentration and at very high substrate concentration.
markscheme: At low substrate concentration, a competitive inhibitor reduces reaction rate because it competes effectively with substrate for active sites.
At very high substrate concentration, the inhibitor effect is reduced because substrate molecules more frequently occupy the active sites.
markschemeJa: 低基質濃度では競争的阻害剤が基質と活性部位を競うため反応速度が低下する。
非常に高い基質濃度では基質が活性部位を占める確率が高くなり、阻害効果は小さくなる。
parts.modelAnswer: A competitive inhibitor has a strong effect at low substrate concentration because it can occupy active sites instead of substrate. At very high substrate concentration, substrate outcompetes the inhibitor more often, so the reduction in rate becomes smaller.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 低い基質濃度では阻害剤が活性部位を占有しやすく、反応速度を大きく低下させます。非常に高い基質濃度では基質が競争に勝ちやすくなるため、阻害効果は小さくなります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: The table shows physiological measurements before and during sustained exercise.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate how many times greater oxygen uptake is during exercise than at rest.
parts.modelAnswer: Oxygen uptake is 2.40 ÷ 0.30 = 8 times greater during exercise.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 運動時の酸素摂取量は2.40÷0.30=8倍です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why oxygen uptake and carbon dioxide output increase during sustained exercise.
markscheme: Contracting muscles have a higher ATP demand during exercise.
The rate of aerobic cellular respiration increases and therefore more oxygen is consumed.
Faster aerobic respiration produces more carbon dioxide, which must be transported away from tissues.
markschemeJa: 運動中は筋収縮によってATP需要が高くなる。
好気的細胞呼吸の速度が上がり、より多くの酸素が消費される。
好気呼吸が速くなると二酸化炭素産生も増え、組織から運び去る必要がある。
parts.modelAnswer: Sustained muscle contraction requires more ATP. Aerobic respiration therefore increases, consuming more oxygen. Increased respiration also produces more carbon dioxide, so carbon dioxide output rises.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 持続的な筋収縮には多くのATPが必要なので好気呼吸が増え、酸素消費量が上がります。同時に呼吸で生じる二酸化炭素も増えるため、排出量も増加します。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how increased ventilation and cardiac output help support the higher rate of respiration in exercising muscle.
markscheme: Increased ventilation helps maintain high oxygen availability and remove carbon dioxide at the gas-exchange surface.
Increased cardiac output transports more oxygen to active muscles and carries carbon dioxide away, helping maintain diffusion gradients.
markschemeJa: 換気量増加によりガス交換面への酸素供給と二酸化炭素除去が増える。
心拍出量増加により活動筋へ多くの酸素を運び、二酸化炭素を運び去ることで拡散勾配を維持しやすくなる。
parts.modelAnswer: Greater ventilation refreshes alveolar air, increasing oxygen supply and carbon dioxide removal. Greater cardiac output moves more oxygenated blood to active muscle and returns carbon dioxide to the lungs, supporting continued aerobic respiration.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 換気量の増加で肺胞の空気がより速く入れ替わり、酸素供給と二酸化炭素除去が増えます。心拍出量の増加で活動筋へより多くの酸素を運び、二酸化炭素を肺へ戻せるため、好気呼吸を維持できます。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A plant heterozygous for a gene with complete dominance was self-crossed. The observed offspring were 148 dominant phenotype and 52 recessive phenotype.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: If 200 offspring are expected in a 3:1 phenotypic ratio, calculate the expected number with the recessive phenotype.
markscheme: 200 × 1 ÷ 4 = 50 offspring.
parts.modelAnswer: A 3:1 ratio predicts one quarter recessive, so 200 × 1 ÷ 4 = 50 recessive offspring.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 3:1では劣性表現型は4分の1なので、200×1÷4=50個体です。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the observed number of recessive offspring with the expected number.
markscheme: The observed value is 52, which is 2 higher than the expected value of 50 (and is close to the expectation).
markschemeJa: 観察値52は期待値50より2多く、期待値に近い。
parts.modelAnswer: There were 52 recessive offspring compared with 50 expected, a difference of only 2.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 劣性表現型は期待値50に対して観察値52で、差は2個体です。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how segregation of alleles in meiosis can produce an approximately 3:1 phenotypic ratio in this self-cross.
markscheme: The heterozygous parent produces gametes carrying the dominant allele and recessive allele because the two alleles segregate during meiosis.
Random fertilization can produce AA, Aa and aa genotypes in an expected 1:2:1 ratio.
With complete dominance, AA and Aa show the dominant phenotype while aa is recessive, giving an expected 3:1 phenotypic ratio.
markschemeJa: ヘテロ接合体では減数分裂時に2つの対立遺伝子が分離し、優性対立遺伝子または劣性対立遺伝子をもつ配偶子ができる。
ランダムな受精によりAA、Aa、aaが期待上1:2:1で生じる。
完全優性ではAAとAaが優性表現型、aaが劣性表現型となるため、表現型比は3:1になる。
parts.modelAnswer: A heterozygote makes gametes carrying either allele because the alleles segregate during meiosis. Random fusion of these gametes gives an expected AA:Aa:aa genotype ratio of 1:2:1. Because the dominant allele masks the recessive allele in heterozygotes, three quarters are expected to show the dominant phenotype and one quarter the recessive phenotype.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ヘテロ接合体では減数分裂によって対立遺伝子が分離し、どちらか一方をもつ配偶子ができます。ランダム受精によりAA:Aa:aa=1:2:1が期待され、完全優性ならAAとAaが優性表現型になるため、表現型は3:1になります。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A bacterial population was exposed to the same antibiotic over several generations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Describe the change in frequency of the resistance allele across the generations.
markscheme: The resistance allele frequency increases across the generations.
It rises from 0.08 at generation 0 to 0.71 at generation 12, with the largest overall change occurring after antibiotic exposure continues.
markschemeJa: 耐性対立遺伝子の頻度は世代を通して上昇している。
0世代の0.08から12世代の0.71へ上昇し、抗生物質への曝露が続く中で大きく増えている。
parts.modelAnswer: Resistance allele frequency increases steadily, from 0.08 initially to 0.71 by generation 12.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 耐性対立遺伝子頻度は0世代の0.08から12世代の0.71まで継続的に上昇しています。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain how natural selection can account for the change in allele frequency.
markscheme: Heritable variation in antibiotic resistance was present in the population before or during exposure.
In the presence of the antibiotic, resistant bacteria survive and reproduce more successfully than susceptible bacteria.
Resistant bacteria pass the resistance allele to more descendants, so its frequency increases over generations; the antibiotic does not make every bacterium mutate because it needs resistance.
markschemeJa: 抗生物質への耐性に関する遺伝可能な変異が集団内に存在していた。
抗生物質存在下では耐性菌が感受性菌より生存・繁殖しやすい。
耐性菌がより多くの子孫へ耐性対立遺伝子を伝えるため、世代を重ねて頻度が上昇する。抗生物質が必要に応じて全細菌に同じ突然変異を起こすわけではない。
parts.modelAnswer: The population contains heritable variation in resistance. Antibiotic treatment creates a selection pressure: resistant bacteria are more likely to survive and reproduce, so they contribute more copies of the resistance allele to later generations. The allele therefore becomes more common over time.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 集団には耐性に関する遺伝可能な変異があります。抗生物質が選択圧となり、耐性菌の方が生存・繁殖に成功しやすいため、耐性対立遺伝子を次世代へより多く残します。その結果、世代を重ねて頻度が上昇します。

stimulus.title: Resistance allele frequency
stimulus.note: The antibiotic concentration was kept constant throughout the experiment.
